title: Personal-Best Leaderboard by Species
dataSources: Fishing catches (`fishing:catch`), fishfinder sonar (`fishfinder:reading`), foraging finds (`foraging:find`), game-cam triggers (`gamecam:trigger`).
app: Outdoor logs — fishing apps (Fishbrain), sonar / fishfinder exports, game/trail cameras, and foraging journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fishing:catch
| stats max(weight_kg) as pb_weight, max(length_cm) as pb_length, latest(_time) as last by species
| sort - pb_weight
description: Keeps a personal-best leaderboard of your biggest fish per species, the record every angler wants.
value: A living personal-best table celebrates milestones and gives you a clear target to beat next time out.
implementation: Ingest catches into `index=personal`; track the biggest per species.
visualization: Ranked table of personal-best fish by species.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps a record of your biggest fish of each kind, the personal bests every angler is proud of.
